meaning: A word or phrase with a # in front. Posts use it so people can find others on the same topic.
clues: You see it in social media posts.
It's a word or phrase marked with the # sign, to sort a post by topic.
Tap one and you can usually see other posts that share it.
Holidays, events, and causes often have their own.
It has seven letters and starts with H.
assumes: A caption is plain words with no special sign
A username is a name for one person, not a topic

decoys.meaning: Words that go with a picture or post to explain it.
A funny picture or video that people pass around online.
A name that shows who you are on a website or social media.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: The library card catalog had subject cards, so you could find books on one topic. This sounds like the same idea.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Try it with someone you trust. In a social media app, type a # and a word like a holiday into the search box, then look at what comes up. Just look, no need to post.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: A label that gathers everything on one subject. Now that I understand.
